description: This PHP source file defines a 'Model' class within the 'MPF\Core\DB' namespace. The class provides an ORM-like interface for database operations, including table creation, migration, CRUD operations, joins, and query building. It manages SQL query construction, execution, and schema modifications, and includes static methods for defining column types and constraints.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: A class providing ORM-like database interaction, schema migration, and query building functionalities within the 'MPF\Core\DB' namespace.

methods.name: Debug
methods.description: Outputs debug messages or throws exceptions based on environment variable 'DEBUG'.

methods.name: PK
methods.description: Returns the SQL string for a primary key column.

methods.name: int
methods.description: Returns SQL string for an integer column with optional nullability and default value.

methods.name: char
methods.description: Returns SQL string for a VARCHAR column with specified length, nullability, and default.

methods.name: decimal
methods.description: Returns SQL string for a DECIMAL column with precision, scale, nullability, and default.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns SQL string for a TEXT column with optional nullability.

methods.name: bool
methods.description: Returns SQL string for a boolean column with optional default value.

methods.name: enum
methods.description: Returns SQL string for an ENUM column with specified choices, nullability, and default.

methods.name: date
methods.description: Returns SQL string for a DATE column, with optional default to current date.

methods.name: datetime
methods.description: Returns SQL string for a DATETIME column, with optional default to current timestamp.

methods.name: GETCOL
methods.description: Retrieves the column type for a given field name from the model's fields array.

methods.name: FK
methods.description: Generates a foreign key constraint string referencing another model's column, only for INT types.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the database table associated with the model instance.

methods.name: migration
methods.description: Creates a migration file for the current model with timestamped class name.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs migration, creating or updating the database table and migration files.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Constructs and executes SQL to create the database table based on model fields and foreign keys.

methods.name: verifyTable
methods.description: Checks if the table exists in the database.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Drops the associated database table, disabling foreign key checks temporarily.

methods.name: editTable
methods.description: Alters the table schema by adding, modifying, or removing columns based on provided values and action.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Prepares a delete query with specified conditions, disallowing subsequent find calls.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Initializes a select query for specified columns, disallowing multiple calls.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Initializes a count query for specified columns, disallowing multiple calls.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Adds WHERE conditions to the query, only after find, update, or join.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Adds AND conditions to the existing WHERE clause.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Adds OR conditions to the existing WHERE clause.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Adds ORDER BY clause based on model and column, with ascending or descending order.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Adds LIMIT and OFFSET to the query.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Prepares an UPDATE statement with specified values, disallowing multiple calls.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Adds an INNER JOIN with another model/table and specified columns.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Specifies join conditions between tables.

methods.name: onor
methods.description: Specifies OR join conditions between tables.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the constructed query, handling SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE, and JOIN queries.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the table with provided values, returning the inserted record.

methods.name: RawQuery
methods.description: Executes a raw SQL query and returns all results.

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Returns a greater-than comparison array for query building.

methods.name: gte
methods.description: Returns a greater-than-or-equal comparison array for query building.

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Returns a less-than comparison array for query building.

methods.name: lte
methods.description: Returns a less-than-or-equal comparison array for query building.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Returns a LIKE comparison array for query building.
